prompt: A relay race: carry the baton to each of the three checkpoints

intent.setting: Open outdoor terrain with clear views and natural obstacles: dirt paths wind from an entrance to a central clearing; a calm pond off one path, a shaded grove on a knoll with fireflies, a small camp with a stone table nearby, two side open spaces serve as team bases, and a lookout up a steep side slope is reached only by jumping.
intent.goal: Successive players each run from their team base on the course, pick up the baton, and carry it to three designated checkpoints along the nature trail in order, then hand it to the next teammate who continues on an identical route. The team whose last runner touches the finish pad first with the baton wins.
intent.fail: The relay fails if any runner drops the baton and does not pick it up again before reaching the next checkpoint, or if a runner leaves the marked path for more than a few steps (course penalty).
intent.headline: Relay route must include three sequential baton checkpoints with a drop penalty.
